description: Cross-dataset object-scale distribution and within-dataset COCO AP_S comparison

provenance.dataset_1_protocol: test split, 220 images, seed 42 best checkpoints
provenance.dataset_2_metrics: docs/paper/latex/main.tex Table VI; checkpoint-linked training evaluation logs
provenance.dataset_2_protocol: validation split, 500 images; KaryoFlow three-seed mean, other detectors seed 42

evidence_boundary: AP_S values are compared only within each dataset. Dataset 1 and Dataset 2 use different splits and seed aggregation, so raw cross-dataset AP_S levels are not interpreted as a paired difference.
